verdict.rationale: Fenwick operates client-facing technology such as the custom trademark extranet and AI tools, which store client data, so a data-residency question applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any choice of storage region or residency. The privacy practice is legal advice and the offices list concerns physical locations; neither is a data-residency control.
